D: A girl with magic hair leaves her tower for the first time to see the floating lanterns.
P: Serve the mains when Mother Gothel promises to make hazelnut soup.
S: Puff pastry rolls of pork mince, onion and sage
Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mustard.
Maximus's crisp apple and fennel salad
Shaved apple, fennel and celery with toasted walnuts, rocket, cheddar and honey mustard

A bowl of the palace horse's favourite thing, sliced thin and crisp enough to bribe him off Flynn's trail. Toast 80g walnuts in a dry pan. Whisk the juice of a lemon with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp wholegrain mustard and salt. Thinly slice 3 crisp red apples, a fennel bulb and a few inner celery stalks and toss straight into the dressing so the apple stays white. Fold through 100g rocket and the celery leaves, then top with the walnuts and shaved aged cheddar.

M: Potato and toasted hazelnut soup with celery
Toasted hazelnuts blended with onion, celery and potato simmered in chicken stock, finished with cream and topped with crushed hazelnuts and chives.
spatchcocked bird with garlic and lemon, roasted to a smoky char over crispy potatoes, yoghurt

Chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and lemon, roasted with a smoky char, over crispy potatoes with herby yoghurt. Cut out the backbone of a 1.8kg chicken and press flat. Rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, the zest of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt. Lay over 1kg sliced potatoes tossed in oil in a roasting tin and roast at 220C for 50 minutes until charred and cooked through. Rest 10 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice, parsley and mint to serve.
W: Whole boiled orange and almond meal cake
Orange and almond cakes baked in muffin tins at 170C for 25 minutes, glazed with orange syrup and topped with a candied orange slice.
lemon sponges piped with pale purple blueberry buttercream, the royal emblem in gold sugar

Lemon cupcakes piped with lilac blueberry buttercream and topped with a golden sugar sun, the royal emblem of Corona. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, the zest of 1 lemon, 125ml milk and 200g self-raising flour. Spoon into 12 paper cases and bake at 175C for 18 minutes, then cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 2 tbsp blueberry jam until fluffy and lilac. Pipe onto the cakes and top each with a yellow fondant sun cut with a small cutter.
K: Lavender syrup and lemon juice over ice

Homemade lavender syrup with fresh lemon and soda over ice, pale purple like Rapunzel's dress, with a lemon wheel and a lavender sprig. Simmer 150g sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp dried culinary lavender for 5 minutes, cool and strain. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 40ml syrup and the juice of half a lemon to each and top with 200ml soda water.

s.note: Puff pastry rolls of pork mince, onion and sage
s.how: Mix 500g pork mince with a grated onion, chopped sage and salt. Lay along 2 halved puff pastry sheets, roll up and seal. Brush with beaten egg, cut into pieces and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with English mustard and a dream.

m.note: Potato and toasted hazelnut soup with celery
m.how: Toast 150g hazelnuts and rub off the skins. Soften a diced onion and 2 celery sticks in butter, add 400g diced potatoes, most of the hazelnuts and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 25 minutes, blend smooth and stir in 150ml cream. Top with crushed hazelnuts and chives.

w.note: Whole boiled orange and almond meal cake
w.how: Boil 2 whole oranges for an hour, cool and blend smooth. Whisk 6 eggs with 220g sugar and a teaspoon of baking powder, then fold in the orange and 250g almond meal. Bake in muffin tins at 170C for 25 minutes. Glaze with orange syrup and honey.
